name: Continuous/TDS blowdown control, flash vessels, blowdown heat-recovery exchangers
description: Continuously remove concentrated boiler water to hold TDS below foaming/carryover limits; reduce energy and water loss by flashing to low pressure, recovering flash steam to the feedtank/deaerator, and cooling residual blowdown through a heat exchanger that preheats make-up before discharge.

specifications.metric: Conventional shell-boiler boiler-water TDS operating range
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: 2000 ppm very small boilers to 3500 ppm larger boilers, provided near design pressure and moderate load
Spirax Sarco on/off blowdown valve control illustration
specifications.value: open at 3000 ppm; close at 2700 ppm (10% band)

specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco worked example; downstream pressure assumed 0.5 bar g
specifications.value: 1111 kg/h through ~3.6 mm orifice; 10 mm seat with needle set to 9.33 mm

specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: water at saturation drops almost full boiler pressure across the orifice

specifications.metric: Flash fraction from 10 bar g to 0.5 bar g
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco heat-recovery worked example; boiler saturation 184 °C; hfg at 0.5 bar g = 2226 kJ/kg

specifications.metric: Flash steam energy share of blowdown
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco example (97 kW recoverable in flash steam vs 241 kW total blown down, 0 °C datum)
Spirax Sarco equipment requirement; vessels built to recognised pressure-vessel standard e.g. PD 5500

specifications.metric: Blowdown heat recovery via flash vessel
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco (flash vessel and associated equipment, before residual heat recovery)

specifications.metric: Residual blowdown temperature after heat exchanger
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco: residual blowdown from 0.5 bar g flash vessel at about 105 °C cooled to ~20 °C heating make-up water

specifications.metric: Total recovery with flash steam + residual heat exchanger
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco summary of complete heat-recovery arrangement
specifications.value: 82% of original blowdown energy; 14% by mass of water recovered

specifications.metric: Bottom blowdown example (10 bar g, 40 mm line, 10 m equivalent length)
specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco Bottom Blowdown worked example; minimum reasonable blowdown line length 7.5 m
specifications.value: 6.2 kg/s; hf 782 kJ/kg → 4.85 MW; 16% flashes to atmosphere

specifications.basis: Spirax Sarco extracting HSE Guidance Note PM60; design temperature >= saturation temperature at vessel design pressure
DOE Steam Sourcebook, Boiler Blowdown System section
specifications.value: should never be permitted unless recommended by boiler manufacturer; above 700 psig may cause water starvation
ASME VIII Div 1 2015; Pressure Equipment Safety Regulations 2016; CEA BG03
